definitions.PROVEN_PRE_CUTOFF: A retrieved pre-cutoff preserved payload has authenticated capture/custody timing and matches the exact recorded late CP3 version content_hash with documented representation. None obtained.
definitions.PROVEN_FRAGMENT_PRE_CUTOFF: A verified pre-cutoff payload contains the exact case-sensitive frozen fragment text; full CP3 version identity remains NOT_PROVEN. Coverage is listed per fragment. All 11 positive versions cover every selected fragment.
definitions.NOT_PROVEN: No qualifying preserved payload found in the completed bounded automated searches. This is not proof of historical nonexistence.
disallowed_shortcuts: printed PDF date or PDF CreationDate alone
similar wording or another actor without identity/context review
definitions.gate_rule: ADMITTED requires complete admission checks. Critical unresolved actor/group/time mapping or unauthenticated required inputs -> BLOCKED; noncritical incomplete checks -> PARTIAL. READY_TO_DISTRIBUTE only with all 12 ADMITTED and authorized frozen inputs. Missing basis for a numeric answer alone is not an admission failure.
